translit: Bismillāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn. Wa-ṣallallāhu wa-sallama wa-bāraka ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn. Rabbi shraḥ lī ṣadrī wa-yassir lī amrī wa-ḥlul ʿuqdatam min lisānī yafqahū qawlī. Allāhumma ʿallimnā mā yanfaʿunā wa-nfaʿnā bimā ʿallamtanā wa-zidnā ʿilmā.

text: [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]] today we will start where we left off last week, when we spoke about the father of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, [[Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib|عبد الله بن عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]],
and how Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] saved him from being slaughtered. And we spoke about that story last week,
how the father of Abdullah, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], who is the grandfather of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, how he had vowed that if he had ten sons, that he would sacrifice one of them.
But then in the end, instead of doing that, he sacrificed one hundred camels. And [[Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib|عبد الله بن عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], the father of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, was saved.
And that is why the Prophet ﷺ said: '[[Ana ibnudh-dhabihayn|أنا ابن الذبيحين]] - I am the son of the two who were about to be slaughtered.'
And that would be [[Ismail|إسماعيل]] [[alayhis-salam|عليه السلام]] and Abdullah, the father of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.
So Abdullah was saved in this way, and a hundred camels were sacrificed instead.
And when Abdullah grew up, he was the most beloved son to his father. He was the most beloved son to [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]].
So when he became of an age where he was ready to get married, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] wanted him to marry the best woman.
So he decided to marry his son to [[Aminah bint Wahb|آمنة بنت وهب]]. And [[Aminah bint Wahb|آمنة بنت وهب]], who is the mother of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ,
she also came from a very pure and respectable and honorable lineage.
And she also was from the descendants of [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]]. As we mentioned earlier that the Prophet ﷺ and his lineage,
he is Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] ibn [[Hashim|هَاشِم]] ibn [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]] ibn [[Qusayy ibn Kilab|قُصَيّ بن كِلَاب]].
So [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]] was one of the sons of [[Qusayy ibn Kilab|قُصَيّ بن كِلَاب]], and [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ's lineage goes back to him
from the father's side, and also from the mother's side.

So both [[Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib|عبد الله بن عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] and [[Aminah bint Wahb|آمنة بنت وهب]], the parents of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, they were from a very high and respectable lineage from the [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]],
and they were both from the children, the descendants of [[Ismail|إسماعيل]] [[alayhis-salam|عليه السلام]]. So the Prophet ﷺ was born into the most honorable lineage.
His family tree is the most honorable lineage.
So when [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] wanted his son to get married, he decided to marry him to [[Aminah bint Wahb|آمنة بنت وهب]].

Now [[Aminah bint Wahb|آمنة بنت وهب]], she lived with her family in [[Yathrib|يثرب]]. They didn't live in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], they lived in [[Yathrib|يثرب]]. And [[Yathrib|يثرب]], of course, would later on

become to be known as [[al-Madinah al-Nabawiyyah|الْمَدِينَة النَّبَوِيَّة]], the city of the Prophet ﷺ, because that is eventually where he made [[Hijrah|هِجْرَة]] to. But at that time, it was not called [[Madinah|مدينة]], it was called [[Yathrib|يثرب]].
And that is where the mother of the Prophet ﷺ, [[Aminah bint Wahb|آمنة بنت وهب]], and her family, they used to live there in [[Yathrib|يثرب]].
So when the marriage was agreed upon, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] took his son Abdullah to [[Yathrib|يثرب]], and the marriage took place in [[Yathrib|يثرب]].
So the marriage of the parents of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was done in [[Yathrib|يثرب]]. And then after the marriage, they returned to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
So Abdullah, with his new wife Aminah, they came from [[Madinah|مدينة]] to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]]. And shortly after the marriage, Aminah, she became pregnant.
And Abdullah, the father of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, died just a few months into his wife's pregnancy.
So when [[Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib|عبد الله بن عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] died, his wife [[Aminah bint Wahb|آمنة بنت وهب]] was pregnant with [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.
So the father of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ died even before he was born. So [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was an orphan even before his birth.
Now when the time of the birth of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ came near, now Aminah, she is in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
So when the time of the birth of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ came near, Aminah, she saw a dream. She saw a dream that she's giving birth to this boy,
and along with this boy, a great light is coming out, an illuminating light that illuminates the earth,
and it can be seen all the way up to Busra in [[Sham|شام]]. So with this boy, this great illumination is coming out.
She also saw in a dream that she was saying about this boy who was being born:

translit: Uʿīdhuhu bi-Llāhi l-Wāḥid min sharri kulli ḥāsid

text: I seek the protection of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] for this boy. I seek the protection of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], the One, for this boy, from the evil of every jealous person.

So even though the [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]], they were [[mushrikin|مشركين]], they used to worship idols and they used to associate partners with Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], in her dream, she is seeking refuge in Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] alone for this boy. So these were some of the dreams that she saw near the time that [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was born.
And then on the twelfth of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]], in the Year of the Elephant, [[Am al-Fil|عام الفيل]],

and the [[Am al-Fil|عام الفيل]], we spoke about that before, that was the year that the incident happened where [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] came from [[Yemen|اليمن]] to destroy the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], and how Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] destroyed [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and his army, and He protected His house, He protected the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].

So that was the year where [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was born. On the twelfth of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]], according to the most authentic opinion. And there is some [[ikhtilaf|اختلاف]] on the date of his birth,

not all of the [[ulama|علماء]] are agreed that he was born on the twelfth of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]], but perhaps it is the strongest opinion that he was born on Monday, the twelfth of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]].

Surely he was born on a Monday, but there is some [[ikhtilaf|اختلاف]] about the date, was it the twelfth of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]] or another date. But the most authentic opinion [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]] is that it was the twelfth of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]].

So on Monday, the twelfth of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]], in [[Am al-Fil|عام الفيل]], the Year of the Elephant, the year that Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] destroyed [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and his army,

the greatest man who ever walked on the earth was born. And this happened fifty days after the incident of [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and his army. Fifty days after Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] destroyed [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and his army, the Prophet ﷺ was born.
So this was one of the great events in the history of mankind, the birth of the greatest creation of Allah, [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.
